{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans are guided by the conviction that no nation can build a safer, better world alone.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States is committed to lasting institutions like the United Nations and the World Trade Organization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"International organizations can serve the cause of peace, but can never serve as a substitute for, or exercise a veto over, principled American leadership.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"American troops must never serve under United Nations command, as a matter of U.S. sovereignty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United Nations can provide a valuable forum for nations to peacefully resolve their differences.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United Nations can help monitor international agreements and organize international humanitarian assistance.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Under Republican leadership, the United States will pay a fair, not disproportionate, share of dues to the United Nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United Nations must continue to reform its management and take steps to eliminate waste, fraud, and abuse.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"All funds that the U.S. contributes for operations, conferences, and peacekeeping should count against its United Nations dues.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
